label: Arduino Opta — MCSA monitor

telemetrySchema.mcsa: Cooked spectra with fund/rotor/bearing/ecc/stator plus load groups fan|pump|compressor|turbine based on deviceType 0–5.
telemetrySchema.env: When I/O layout=HVAC: T1_C..T4_C, WATER_ROPE_MV, WR_DETECT, WR_INPUT_ON, COMP_FLT, FAN_FLT.
telemetrySchema.edgeAi: compressor/fan labels in HVAC layout; pump-1/pump-2 in lift layout.
telemetrySchema.deviceType: 0 base, 1 fan, 2 pump, 3 compressor, 4 turbine, 5 all — configured on Opta /mcsa.

notes: HVAC configs B/D: /mcsa → I/O layout HVAC, motor wiring 1P + start cap (not plain 1P). Compressor run CT I1, fan run CT I2. Edge AI model single-phase-start-v1. Config A blower: run I2, start I3.
